what_happened: Scene layout 10 / style 10: dark sink, faucet with a short cylindrical side lever; romaine (Lettuce010) in a perforated colander on the counter LEFT of the sink. Stage 0 slow: the gripper was on the lever continuously 138-499 (one touch interval); the handle sat at ~0 until ~400 (the 6.28 samples 176-400 are the packet's wrap-then-abs artifact for an angle a hair below 0, so effectively 0: pressed marginally toward the off side, not turned), then rose 0.03-0.21 (416-480) and 0.49 at 496. Water on at 493 (median 253, p90 449). Stage 1 normal: arm swung left, grasped the colander rim at 644 (width 0.037), carried it right, and held it under the stream from ~768 (wrist view: the stream lands on the lettuce 768-784); success at 784 (291 steps).
self_recovery: Recovered on its own from a ~260-step lever stall (138-400); finished with 316 steps to spare.
official_criterion_notes: fixture value 6.28 = packet tooling artifact (angle a hair below 0 wrapped mod 2pi then abs); effective angle min(v, 2pi-v) ~ 0; water_on false in state_every_32_steps, consistent with the video.
